instruction: Feed 4:5, 1080x1350. Background in Kapruka Purple #3C096C fading to #100223. Both watches have a soft contact shadow. Headline for top watch: “Minimalist Elegance” in Inter Black, white. Support line below: “Everyday Sophistication” in Inter Medium, white. Headline for bottom watch: “Chronograph Style” in Inter Black, white. Support line below: “Timeless Precision” in Inter Medium, white. Use a Gold #D9A441 fine line between watches. Lighting soft and warm to highlight premium quality. NEGATIVE: no price tags, no discount badges, no stars, no busy patterns, no buttons, no app UI, no second Kapruka logo, no alcohol imagery.
